title: tool.span@1
description: One tool call as the agent's own telemetry saw it: how long it took and how long of that it waited on you.

writer.description: Who wrote it, from the connection: the OTLP receiver, from the agent's own telemetry.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

tool.description: The tool's name as the agent sent it.

tool_use_id.description: The tool call's ID, when the span carries one.

duration_ms.description: The whole call, from the span.

blocked_ms.description: How long the call waited on you; null when it never asked.

decision.description: What you decided when it asked, as the agent names it; null when it never asked.

reading.description: The reading it adds to, its model or tool name folded by the agent's facts: a name they don't list reads as other.
